description: Returns the derivation ledger index. With a symbol: up to 20 recent archived upstream fetches behind that network, each with time, verify_url, the SHA-256 and size of the raw payload, the collector code hash and the fetch status, so a published value can be traced to the exact bytes and build that produced it (the payload bytes themselves are the paid derivation_replay product). A network with live data that the ledger does not cover yet returns entries: [] with ledger_status not_yet_covered and the covered symbols. Without a symbol: every covered symbol with its latest fetch time and entry count. Read-only, no key. To compare a live value with its upstream right now, use verify_value.

symbol.description: Optional: one network symbol, case-insensitive (e.g. AKT). Omit for the coverage list.

name: get_derivation_ledger
title: Get the derivation ledger
